scope: One-seed offline accuracy diagnostic; no runtime benefit claimed

protocol.operator: dense A=K+lambda I, identical across all ordinary-PCG branches
protocol.coarse_selection: largest generalized Ritz values of (A,M_old) in first20 PCG search span
protocol.projected_initial_diagonal: actual diag(Q K Q) or diag(B), not ones
protocol.schur_kernel: B=K+lambda U U.T-AU (U.T A U)^-1 AU.T
